title: Withdrawal from the District and Close of the School Year
content:
## Withdrawal

- Under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, only the parent or guardian of record signs the district withdrawal form. The support desk explains the form and the leaver reasons, but the withdrawal is the family's own action.
- The withdrawal takes the last day of attendance as its withdrawal date, and the leaver reason is the one the family states on the form. A withdrawal moves an enrollment from enrolled to withdrawn.
- A district withdrawal ends the student's other district programs on the same date: the School Nutrition Services Meal Account becomes inactive, Student Transportation eligibility ends with the end reason "district withdrawal", and an open Creek Kids Club enrollment ends.

## Close of the school year

- At the close of the school year every enrolled record is completed, and the last instructional day of the school year is recorded as its closing date.
- A grade 12 graduate is completed with the leaver reason "graduated"; every other completed record carries no leaver reason ("not applicable").

## What happens on the withdrawal date (hypothetical case)

A parent of record signs the withdrawal form, and the student's last day of attendance is a Thursday. On that Thursday:

| Record | Effect |
|---|---|
| Enrollment | withdrawn; withdrawal date is that Thursday; leaver reason as written on the form |
| School Nutrition Services Meal Account | inactive from that Thursday |
| Student Transportation eligibility | ends that Thursday, end reason "district withdrawal" |
| Creek Kids Club enrollment, if one is open | ends that Thursday |

A grandparent who is not the guardian of record cannot sign the form, because the form is signed only by the parent or guardian of record.
